capture_contract: first 20 future eligible material transactions only
append through atomic temp-write + fsync + replace
if canonicalization or persistence fails, close epoch immediately without posthoc repair
hard_targets: 20/20 subject transactions externally witnessed before counting
measurement_infrastructure_excluded_from: GitHub writes whose sole purpose is persisting the R16C freeze or witness checkpoint
fresh reads whose sole purpose is verifying a witness checkpoint or freeze artifact
local append/candidate-generation operations of the measurement ledger itself

measurement_integrity.unit_tests: 7/7 PASS after preserved R1 design failure

stop_rule: If any eligible subject transaction cannot be contemporaneously canonicalized, externally witnessed, or persisted, close epoch immediately; do not reconstruct post hoc.

transaction_unit.provider_return: one preserved provider return plus canonical adjudication
transaction_unit.subject_mutation: one consequential action spanning required pre-state, submission and resulting-state verification
transaction_unit.subject_read: one material external retrieval/verification that can change research/action state

witness_protocol: Every subject transaction is canonicalized first.
Before append, local ledger must exactly match latest external witness.
Append emits one checkpoint candidate for immutable evidence state.
Checkpoint candidate is persisted to a unique GitHub research path.
Fresh GitHub fetch must exactly match candidate.
Only after fresh external match is subject transaction WITNESSED and counted.
No next subject transaction may append until previous witness is externally verified.
